lat-ecc: Boreās et Sōl dē vīribus inter sē certābant. Placuit eīs eī palmam darī, quī prior hominem viātōrem veste exuisset. Boreās prīncipiō saevus erat; homine autem vestem retinēnte, ācrius instābat. Homō vērō, frīgore magis magisque oppressus, vestem insuper induit, dōnec Boreās dēfessus eum Sōlī trādidit. Sōl prīmō moderātē fulsit; homine autem superfluam vestem pōnente, aestum auxit, dōnec ille, aestum ferre nōn valēns, veste exūtā, flūmine prope praeterfluente, lavātum abiit. Fābula docet persuāsiōnem saepe vī potentiōrem esse.

grc: Βορέας καὶ Ἥλιος περὶ δυνάμεως ἤριζον. Ἔδοξε δὲ αὐτοῖς ἐκείνῳ τὴν νίκην ἀπονεῖμαι, ὃς ἂν αὐτῶν ἄνθρωπον ὁδοιπόρον ἀποδύσῃ. Καὶ ὁ Βορέας ἀρξάμενος σφοδρὸς ἦν· τοῦ δὲ ἀνθρώπου ἀντεχομένου τῆς ἐσθῆτος μᾶλλον ἐπέκειτο. Ὁ δὲ ὑπὸ τοῦ ψύχους καταπονούμενος ἔτι μᾶλλον, καὶ περιττοτέραν ἐσθῆτα προσελάμβανεν, ἕως ἀποκαμὼν ὁ Βορέας τῷ Ἡλίῳ μεταπαρέδωκε. Κἀκεῖνος τὸ μὲν πρῶτον μετρίως προσέλαμψε· τοῦ δὲ ἀνθρώπου τὰ περισσὰ τῶν ἱματίων ἀποτιθεμένου, σφοδρότερον τὸ καῦμα ἐπέτεινεν, ἕως οὗ πρὸς τὴν ἀλέαν ἀντέχειν μὴ δυνάμενος, ἀποδυσάμενος, ποταμοῦ παραρρέοντος ἐπὶ λουτρὸν ἀπῄει. Ὁ λόγος δηλοῖ, ὅτι πολλάκις τὸ πείθειν τοῦ βιάζεσθαι ἀνυστικώτερόν ἐστι.
eme: The North Wind and the Sun disputed which of them was the stronger. They agreed that the victory should be given unto him that first could strip a wayfaring man of his clothes. The North Wind began, and blew most fiercely; but the man holding fast his cloak, the Wind pressed him the harder. The man, being yet more pinched with the cold, put on another garment besides, until the North Wind, grown weary, gave him over to the Sun. The Sun at the first shone temperately; but when the man put off his spare garment, the Sun increased the heat, until the man, not able to abide the warmth, put off all his clothes and went to wash himself in a river that ran hard by. The fable showeth that fair speech is oftentimes mightier than force.
enm: The north wynd and the sonne weren at stryf, which of hem was the strengere. And they accordeden that he sholde han the maistrie that first myghte maken a man that wente by the weye doon of his mantel. The north wynd bigan and was right fel; and the man helde faste his mantel, and the wynd leyde on the harder. But the man, ygreved yet moore by the cold, dide on hym another cote, til that the north wynd, al wery, bitook hym to the sonne. The sonne at the firste shoon softely; and whan the man hadde doon of his othere clothes, the sonne made the hete the gretter, til that the man, that myghte nat suffren the hete, dide of alle his clothes and wente hym for to bathen in a ryver that ran ther bisyde. This tale sheweth that fayre speche may ofte moore availlen than strengthe.
ang: Se norþerna wind and sēo sunne fliton him betwēonan hwæðer heora strengra wǣre. Hīe geþafodon þæt se þone sige hæfde, þe ǣrest meahte his hrægles berēafian þone mann þe on wege fōr. Se norþerna wind ongan and wæs swīþe rēþe; ac se mann hēold his hrægl fæste, and se wind þȳ heardor on hine ēode. Se mann þonne, mid cyle swīþor geswenct, dyde him ōþer hrægl on, oþ þæt se norþerna wind, wērig geworden, hine þǣre sunnan ageaf. Sēo sunne æt fruman gemetlīce scān; ac þā se mann his ōþru hræglu of dyde, hēo þȳ hātlicor scān, oþ þæt se mann, þe þā hǣte āberan ne meahte, ealle his hræglu of dyde and ēode tō þǣre ēa þe þǣr nēah flōwde, þæt hē hine þǣr baþode. Þis spell lǣreþ þæt līþu sprǣc biþ oft mihtigra þonne nȳd.
gem-pro: *Sa nurþrô windaz jah sō sunnǭ bi mahtai flitun, hwaþeraz strangizô was. *Þai kwēdun, þat sa segaz nimai, saei airist mannų ana wegai hakulis biraubōdē. *Sa windaz bigann jah swinþaz was. *Aþþan sa mannô hakulą sīnanǭ fastō hehald, jah sa windaz maiz ana inǭ beblō. *Sa mannô kaldō swankidaz anþeranǭ hakulą ana sik lagidē, und sa windaz wōrigaz warþ jah inǭ sunnōni atgaf. *Sō sunnǭ frumist lītilō skain. *Þan sa mannô anþeranǭ hakulą aflagidē, sō maiz haitō skain, und sa mannô maiz þulaną ni maht. *Allanz hakulanz aflagidē jah tō ahwōi, sōei þar nēhwa feflō, iddjē, sik tō þwahanai. *Linþu wurdō strangizô sindi þau naudiz.
ine-pro: *ǵʰimés h₂wéh₁n̥ts sóh₂wl̥ kʷe préti wéwkʷont, kʷóteros méǵh₂yōs h₁ést. *tód dʰh₁ént. *yós pr̥h₃mós h₂nérm̥ wéstīm ápo dʰéh₁t, só ségʰos h₁épt. *h₂wéh₁n̥ts pr̥h₃mós h₂wéh₁t. *h₂nḗr wéstīm h₁épt, h₂wéh₁n̥ts méǵh₂ h₂wéh₁t. *h₂nḗr áliyām wéstīm épi dʰéh₁t. *h₂wéh₁n̥ts h₂nérm̥ sh₂wéney déh₃t. *sóh₂wl̥ pr̥h₃mós ml̥dú léuket. *h₂nḗr áliyām wéstīm ápo dʰéh₁t, sóh₂wl̥ gʷhórmom h₁éuget. *h₂nḗr gʷhórmom né bʰert. *wéstins ápo dʰéh₁t, srewméni h₂énti swe léwh₃to. *ml̥dwíh₂ wṓkʷs méǵh₂yōs h₁ésti wéyh₁es.
sla-pro: *Sěverьnъ větrъ i sъlnьko medju njima sę pьrěšę, kъterъ iz njeju silьnějь bě. *Oni rěšę: pobědǫ jьmetъ tъ, jьže prьvъ mǫža na pǫti svity sъvlěčetъ. *Sěverьnъ větrъ nače i ljutъ bě. *A mǫžь svitǫ svojǫ krěpъko drъža, i větrъ na njь ljutěje věja. *Mǫžь že, studьjǫ pače mǫčenъ, drugǫ svitǫ na sę oblěče, donьde sěverьnъ větrъ umorenъ byvъ jego sъlnьku prědastъ. *Sъlnьko prьvo tixo sija. *A jegda mǫžь drugǫ svitǫ sъvlěče, sъlnьko teplo umnoži, donьde mǫžь, teplo terpěti ne mogъ, vьsę svity sъvlěče i ide kъ rěkě, jaže tu blizъ teče, kǫpatъ sę. *Slovo uči: tixa slovesa silьnějьša sǫtь neže sila.
